items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Randy was staying right across the street from me.

ctx.x: Well, Kid Randy was playing at the Bullets Club. I was living on a rampart between, uh, six and Washington, and the Bullets Club was up there on the eight, and, and what they call it, Dan Neal now. Mm-hmm. And that was, that was, that was much, that was every Monday night, they had a big dance there. Then they had the Santa Singers, or the San Suu Club, or they used to call it Howard Street, but they called it La Salle now.
